confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the firmest. Hotel anchors and bar prices are less certain; cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: General comparison with other large Latin American capitals that combine budget hostels, menu-of-the-day restaurants and mid-range dining. Cocktail (about 3.5 times the beer anchor) and wine glass (about 3 times the beer anchor) follow the local beer relationship.
